theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (F : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (p : Euclid P → Prop), MeasurableSet M → (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (F i)) → μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ i, F i '' B i) = 0 → (∀ i, ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict (B i)), p (F i b)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), p x
